warnings: VLM notes: This P&ID shows a vendor package air cooler or heat exchanger E-234-009 (NOTE 7 — vendor supply) with dual motor-driven fans/blowers (A and B trains) in the lower section, each with local MCC control, LOCAL/REMOTE selection, START/STOP and EMERGENCY STOP hand switches, vibration high-high switches (VSHH-2901A/B), availability and fault indicators, and running/stop status lights. The upper section shows temperature measurement and control associated with the exchanger process streams. RS symbols (restriction spectacle blinds) are shown on all four process nozzle connections with 8-inch line designations. A spectacle blind or restriction orifice is at 0 degree orientation noted on the 8-inch lines. TY-2911 acts as a computing relay receiving input from TT-2917 and feeding TIC-2911. PSD-2917 appears to be a safety device linked to H-234-001 TRIP function on the heating medium side. KV-2904 (NOTE 8) is an actuated valve on the inlet line with CSO block valves on either side. The bottom right shows an off-page connector to line P-234-03304-CD3D-1-N per NOTE 12. F3D and CD3D designations on the right outlet side likely refer to drain and drain collection header connections. The two circular symbols at bottom centre appear to be accumulator pots or seal pots for the fan/motor assemblies. ESD-3200 appears twice (once for each motor train) suggesting a common emergency shutdown loop feeding both MCCs. Diagram quality is moderate; some small text and annotation details may be partially obscured. NOTE 4 and NOTE 10 apply to the field START/STOP switches; NOTE 9 applies to vibration switches. The VENDOR boundary dashed box encompasses E-234-009 and associated trim.
